entries.name: The Idolmaster SP Chinese High Resolution Texture Pack
entries.credits: Original pack and texture work by the IMASSP-TL contributors. EmuCoreA normalized the upstream repository into a deterministic PPSSPP ZIP while retaining the upstream LICENSE and README.
entries.description: Chinese high-resolution replacement textures for Perfect Sun, Wandering Star, and Missing Moon. The archive contains textures.ini and the referenced PNG assets only; it does not contain a game image.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 for the source repository; see the included LICENSE and upstream project notice for game asset attribution

entries.name: La Pucelle: Ragnarok PPSSPP HD UI Texture Pack
entries.credits: Original texture project by althonos; fonts and third-party contributions are credited in the included upstream README. EmuCoreA retains the source README, COPYING.md, CHANGELOG.md, and attribution notice.
entries.description: A normalized PPSSPP UI/font replacement subset from the upstream release. The upstream release archive contained nine image assets while its textures.ini referenced additional absent files; this derivative removes only those dangling mappings so the archive validates and loads safely.
entries.license: CC-NC 1.0 as identified by upstream README; non-commercial redistribution only: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/nc/1.0/

entries.name: WipEout Pure HD Texture Pack
entries.credits: Texture project by reTokyo; Sony/Studio Liverpool copyright and trademark notices are retained in the upstream README. EmuCoreA links to the original repository and does not mirror it.
entries.description: UI-focused PPSSPP HD texture project for WipEout Pure and listed demo regions. Redistribution permission is not stated, so this catalog keeps the exact upstream ZIP link only.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; upstream copyright notice; link-only

entries.name: Peggle Portable HD Texture Pack (PlayStation layout)
entries.credits: Pack by sinceohsix. Peggle trademark and original game assets remain with Electronic Arts; EmuCoreA links to the upstream release and does not mirror it.
entries.description: PPSSPP HD replacement textures for Peggle PSP with the PlayStation controller layout. The upstream archive is preserved as an exact external link because no redistribution license is stated.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; Electronic Arts trademark notice; link-only

entries.name: Fate/Extra PSP HD Texture Pack
entries.credits: Texture project by Ezehokadrim. The upstream README credits original game rights holders and asks users to credit the author; EmuCoreA links to the original repository and does not mirror it.
entries.description: PPSSPP replacement textures for the US PSP release. The repository contains a root textures.ini and 1,991 image assets, with 200 referenced images absent from the snapshot; its README does not state a redistribution license or permission, so this entry keeps the exact upstream ZIP link only.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; upstream README requests author credit and reserves original game rights; link-only

entries.name: Persona 3 Portable HD Chinese Texture Overlay
entries.credits: Original project by PandaQuQ and TridentOfTheAbyss; the upstream README also credits the PPSSPP and Persona Modding communities and identifies the separate DinJerr base pack. EmuCoreA includes the upstream MIT LICENSE and an attribution notice.
entries.description: Chinese HD texture overlay for the Japanese fan-translation release. The upstream textures.ini referenced a separate US base pack and 4,775 absent files; this normalized archive retains the 3,306 present PNG assets and their complete mappings, so the base pack remains a separate prerequisite.
entries.license: MIT License for the upstream repository; LICENSE and attribution notice are included. Original game and separate DinJerr base-pack rights remain with their respective owners.

entries.name: Persona 2: Innocent Sin French HD Texture Patch
entries.credits: French texture patch by the chenetulipe project. The upstream release credits @racawr for the separate original HD base pack and instructs users to apply this patch over it.
entries.description: French UI texture patch for the European PSP release. The exact upstream ZIP contains 37 PNG files under patch/Text and patch/UI but no textures.ini; it must be overlaid on the separate base pack and is therefore cataloged as a source link, not a standalone EmuCoreA downloadable pack.
entries.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the French patch and project-owned assets per upstream README; original base pack and game rights remain with their respective owners; link-only

entries.name: Fate/EXTRA Japanese HD Font Add-on
entries.credits: Japanese HD font add-on by SIEBEN5106. The README identifies the source fonts and their SIL Open Font License 1.1 terms; the texture pack itself has no separate redistribution license, so EmuCoreA links to the upstream snapshot only.
entries.description: Japanese font replacement add-on for the Japanese PSP release. The upstream ZIP contains textures.ini and 16 PNG font textures, but it is designed to be merged into another Fate/EXTRA texture pack and does not include the rest of the game textures; install it only with the upstream instructions.
entries.license: No separate redistribution license stated for the pack; referenced fonts are under SIL Open Font License 1.1; link-only

entries.name: Sword Art Online: Infinity Moment HD Texture Pack
entries.credits: HD texture and cutscene support project by Saramagrean. The upstream README documents compatibility with the original Japanese release or an English-patched release; EmuCoreA links to the original repository and does not mirror it.
entries.description: PPSSPP HD replacement textures for Sword Art Online: Infinity Moment. The exact upstream ZIP contains a root textures.ini and 2,421 PNG assets; it is a large source archive and may be used with the original Japanese game or the separately documented English patch.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; link to upstream only

entries.name: Monster Hunter Freedom Unite HD Retexture
entries.credits: Retexture project by three5media. The upstream README explicitly permits taking and using project materials anywhere and credits MHFURemaster-VakSan and MHFU-HD for some contributed textures; those third-party rights remain with their respective authors. EmuCoreA includes the upstream README and a redistribution notice.
entries.description: Large PPSSPP HD replacement pack for the US PSP release. The normalized archive places the upstream ULUS10391 contents at the ZIP root, retains 5,894 PNG assets and the source README, and removes four dangling mappings whose files were absent from the upstream snapshot.
entries.license: Explicit upstream README permission to use project materials anywhere; no formal SPDX license; third-party texture sources and their rights are preserved in the included upstream README

entries.name: Liberty City Stories Texture Pack
entries.gameTitle: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories
entries.credits: Original pack by SonofUgly. The author states in the PPSSPP forum thread that others are free to use any or all of the project; EmuCoreA preserves the upstream README and identifies the original source.
entries.description: PPSSPP replacement textures for the PSP release. The upstream release contains 285 image assets and 270 valid textures.ini mappings. The upstream archive had dangling mappings; this normalized ZIP removes only mappings whose files were absent and does not modify image bytes.
entries.license: Explicit author permission: SonofUgly wrote “they're free to use any or all of this project” in https://forums.ppsspp.org/showthread.php?pid=142853&tid=22930; no formal SPDX license; original game/third-party source rights remain with their owners
